title: Debt, a new challenge for democracies
subhead: The rise in long-term interest rates drives up the cost of government debt, just as funding needs reach unprecedented levels. Restoring public finances requires unpopular choices and risks fueling the discontent that extremist parties thrive on.

title: War in Ukraine: Constant air raid alerts unsettle daily life in Kyiv
subhead: Since late August, sirens have sounded in the Ukrainian capital at an unprecedented rate not seen since the beginning of Russia's full-scale invasion in February 2022. This new reality has upended routines the city's 3.7 million residents.

title: Sweden, a 'paradise' for the ultra-rich, debates billionaire tax ahead of elections
